glasses_felix: Location varies by time of day. Day 6 was at bathroom_shelf_ba1, Day 7 PM was at nightstand_b1. Do not assume a fixed spot. Check nightstand_b1 in the evening; check bathroom_shelf_ba1 in the morning.

razor_felix: Persistent error. Assumed sink_ba_ba1 on Day 7 AM; actually at bathroom_shelf_ba1. The object consistently resides at bathroom_shelf_ba1 in the morning. Stop checking sink_ba_ba1 for morning queries. Always check bathroom_shelf_ba1.

glass_felix: Highly variable location. Day 7 PM was at dish_rack_k1, Day 8 PM was at counter_k1, but Day 9 PM (22:54) was at cupboard_k1. Previous assumption of counter_k1 for evening was incorrect on Day 9. Do not rely on a single evening spot. Check cupboard_k1, counter_k1, and dish_rack_k1 in the evening. Morning location remains kitchen_table_k1 based on prior data.

mug_felix: Assumed counter_k1; actually kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen table for drinkware.

tablet_felix: Persistent error. Assumed nightstand_b1 or dresser_b1; actually at kitchen_table_k1. Confirmed again on day 4 at 10:02 and day 9 at 09:22. Stop checking bedroom spots (nightstand, dresser); check kitchen table for electronics.
